annotation.title_clean: United response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States' airspace and critical infrastructure
annotation.title_en: United response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States' airspace and critical infrastructure
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament resolution of 9 October 2025 condemning Russian drone and fighter-jet incursions into EU airspace. It calls for counter-UAV capabilities, an EU 'drone wall' and Eastern Flank Watch, increased defence investment, sanctions, cooperation with Ukraine on drones, and amended regulatory frameworks for UAV and counter-UAV deployment.
key_provisions_or_claims: Condemns Russian drone and aircraft incursions as hybrid warfare and calls for coordinated, proportionate responses including shooting down threats.
Welcomes the EU drone wall and Eastern Flank Watch and calls for an operational plan.
Calls for layered counter-drone defence for airports and critical infrastructure, and joint command-and-control centres.
Calls for a dedicated EDA UAV budget, use of SAFE and EDIP, and cooperation with Ukraine on drone production.
Calls for amending EU and national regulatory frameworks to enable UAV and counter-UAV capabilities and for stronger sanctions on Russia.
